note: Measured on this machine by starting the real llama-server and reading its own /props, then driving the production task driver against it. Not copied from any advertised maximum.

machine.caveat: A Laptop SKU. The build plan targets an RTX 5060 without saying desktop or laptop, and whether this is the target machine is not established.

observations.outcome: The production driver's first turn was refused by the server: request (8852 tokens) exceeds the available context size (4096 tokens).
A real model generated 12 characters through the production driver. Trace: agent_start, turn_start, message_start, message_update x3, context_ledger, message_end, turn_end, agent_end.

findings.statement: The tool schemas the runtime sends occupy 8584 tokens before any prompt, system message, history or evidence. A one-word question therefore costs 8852 input tokens.
findings.measured_by: the context_ledger event the production driver emitted on both runs: sections.toolSchema = 8584
findings.consequence: A 4096-token served context cannot complete a single turn of this runtime, whatever the model. The plan's instruction to report actual served context rather than the advertised maximum has a concrete floor on this machine: about 9k tokens are consumed before the work starts.
findings.not_yet_established: Whether the 8584-token schema cost is reducible by the role-scoped tool loading the plan proposes in §4. Nothing here measured that.

findings.statement: The same context_ledger reports window: 0 and headroom: 0.
findings.consequence: The runtime is not being told the served window, so its own budget accounting cannot bound anything. Plan §3 does not list this; it belongs to P03, accurate rendered token accounting.

findings.statement: Spark-X2.5-4B Q8_0 at a 16384 served context leaves 2634 MiB of 8151 MiB free with the desktop also resident.
findings.consequence: The plan's one-heavy-generation-slot policy is consistent with what this card does. Nothing here measured a second resident model, a vision projector, or the OCR service alongside it.

still_unmeasured: Served context and VRAM for Qwen3.5-9B Q4_K_S, Gemma 4 E4B, Gemma 4 12B, Nemotron3-Nano-4B and Unlimited-OCR.
Peak VRAM during generation rather than at rest.
Any figure at all on the plan's target machine, which has not been established to be this one.
